name: Highway Payment Law Part 2
description:
The Minister of Infrastructure is herby made responsible to make a design for the Federal Highway and through setting the ammounts in the payout account set standard payments of the different materials.

As minimum requirements the design and endresult need to be
- same height as the capital (except tunnels under and bridges above oceans including ramps up to them)
- include asphalt drivable paths when the price of ashalt is reasonable

This work shall be done by the group "National Highways Workers" and "Federal Engineers" (Engineers are for those areas that have non standard requirements like tunnels and bridges). Those to include in the groups is at full discretion of the Minister of Infrastructure and Prime Minister who can set requiremnts and requlations before adding them to those titles. The Minister of Infrastucture does remain responsable for the end result of the work that is done.

If additional payments besides the set standard payments through the payout accounts are required they can be done through contracts as desired.

properties.Title: Digging payment (Manual)
properties.UserDescription:
Digging bellow highways (standard height 70) is to be prevented to avoid issues with vehicles to sink bellow the ground.

For tunnels under mounten a payment equal to the account hoilding for mining is made to dig out drivable space. Tunnel height should be at least 6 clear blocks high to allow all verhicles that are drivable to pass through it.

A bonus payment is offered in areas districted by the Minister of Infrastructure or Prime Minister for areas that need extra attention.
